synthetic_system_prefix.kept: tool and parameter names, types, enums, defaults, required lists; the user task text, the tool results and the model outputs

licences.gen: Synthetic: generated by the kit's gen_corpus.py (the project's licence); no third-party text.
licences.m27: Recorded by the project's own recorder: a coding-agent CLI driving the project's serving stack on sandbox tasks. The CLI's own system prompt and tool descriptions are replaced by synthetic text of the same token count (source_stats.cli.synthetic_system_prefix); the user turns, the tool results (the fixture repository's own files) and the model outputs are the project's own.
licences.bfcl: Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard v4 multi-turn data, github.com/ShishirPatil/gorilla (Apache-2.0; data files at commit 26ad99ed of 2025-11-07): questions and function documentation verbatim, the ground truth as the expected calls; tool results synthesized from the documented response schemas (the executable backing classes are not run).
licences.tokenizers: Family tokenizer files at the bellwether-pinned revisions (see families), used to count tokens only; not redistributed.

token_count_method: template-free: system + tools JSON + every message text (content, reasoning, tool-call JSON, tool results) the request of the turn carries; the engines' usage.prompt_tokens at play time is the rendered count

gen_calibration_after_finalize.note: after finalize (nonce line, json_schema response_format on 20 % of the last turns)
